data.title: Pet lovers can heal hearts at 'Beyond The Rainbow'
data.description: <p>River City Bangkok invites everyone to once again embark on a journey that honours the extraordinary bond between humans and their beloved animal companions during "Beyond The Rainbow", which will kick off on Sept 18 and run until Nov 22 at RCB Galleria 1 and 2.</p>

data.title: Two cuffed after school inspection
data.description: CHON BURI: Two Chinese women were arrested for allegedly working at a school in Bang Lamung district without proper permits.

data.title: WHO praises rubella milestone
data.description: Thailand has been recognised by the World Health Organization (WHO) as having eliminated rubella as a public health issue, marking a significant milestone.

data.title: Rosh Hashanah plan sparks debate
data.description: PHUKET: Residents and businesses on the resort island have raised concerns over a planned Rosh Hashanah event at Chabad House Patong on Sept 11, which is expected to attract up to 2,000 participants.

data.title: Teacher in trouble over beatings
data.description: KALASIN: A teacher faces legal action after allegedly beating pupils with bamboo and a feather duster over unfinished homework.

data.title: Calls grow to regulate influencers as a profession
data.description: <p>Thailand is exploring influencer regulation to protect consumers from harmful content and online scams while preserving creators' freedom of expression.</p>

data.title: Sensational Antonelli wins Italian GP from back of grid
data.description: MONZA (ITALY) - Championship leader Kimi Antonelli delivered one of the most sensational triumphs in the long history of the Italian Grand Prix on Sunday when he became the first home winner in 60 years after starting from 19th on the grid.

data.title: Five dead, five injured after Amazon cargo plane overshoots Miami runway
data.description: MIAMI - At least five people were killed when an Amazon cargo plane overshot a runway after it landed Sunday at Miami International Airport, crashed into vehicles and caught fire, officials said.

data.title: More than 140 killed in latest Yemen clashes: military sources
data.description: TAIZ (YEMEN) - Fighting between Yemeni government forces and Iran-backed Houthi rebels in southwest Yemen killed more than 140 combatants between midday Saturday and early Sunday morning, military sources said.

data.title: Lebanon president calls for US help as Israeli strikes kill 7
data.description: ARABSALIM (LEBANON) - Lebanese President Joseph Aoun urged Washington and the international community to help stop Israeli attacks, which killed at least seven people on Sunday despite a truce and a framework deal aimed at halting the violence.

data.title: Battling the blues - Young at risk from city's fast pace, heavy traffic
data.description: <p>In Bangkok's relentless traffic and fast-paced lifestyle, young people are facing mounting pressures that can lead to depression, self-harm and suicidal behaviour.</p>

data.title: Chinese associations 'should reach out to young'
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has urged Thailand's nine Chinese associations to strengthen their role as a bridge with China, attracting younger Chinese investors and technology.</p>

data.title: Farmers oppose EU seed rules in free trade talks
data.description: <p>Farmer, consumer and civil society groups oppose an EU proposal that could tighten companies' rights over seeds, warning it could threaten farmers' rights and food security.</p>

data.title: Budget bill cut ahead of debate
data.description: <p>The 2027 budget bill, worth 3.78 trillion baht, has been cut by 11.162 billion baht ahead of a three-day parliamentary debate on its second and third readings starting on Monday, with MPs set to challenge several major allocations.</p>

data.title: US crew delighted with visit
data.description: <p>The five-day visit of the USS Abraham Lincoln and about 5,000 US Navy personnel ended on Sunday as the aircraft carrier prepared to leave Laem Chabang.</p>

data.title: Confronting abuse
data.description: <p>Democracy activists are often seen as a progressive group that understands equality and human rights. However, over the past few weeks, a female activist using the pseudonym "A" revealed through the online media outlet SocialGaze that she has been sexually abused by a male activist since 2024.</p>

data.title: Oil leak at data centre sparks concerns
data.description: <p>Pollution officials are inspecting a Bangkok data centre after oil-contaminated waste entered drainage pipes, raising concerns that it could reach Rama IX Canal and affect nearby communities.</p>

data.title: Govt set to  appoint new  spokesman
data.description: <p>The government is preparing to reshuffle its communications team, with Ekkapob Pianpises, known as "Dr Ek", tipped to replace Rachada Dhnadirek as government spokesman, according to a source.</p>

data.title: iLaw chief urges public to join rally
data.description: <p>Internet Dialogue on Law Reform (iLaw) director Yingcheep Atchanont has called on the public to join a final rally on Sept 13, a day before the Election Commission (EC) is due to decide whether to prosecute suspects accused of colluding in the 2024 Senate election.</p>

data.title: Amazon cargo plane overshoots Miami runway, hits vehicles, catches fire
data.description: MIAMI - An Amazon cargo plane overshot a runway as it landed Sunday in Miami, crashing into vehicles and catching fire, officials said.

data.title: German AfD supporters jubilant at far right's thumping win
data.description: MAGDEBURG (GERMANY) - Letting out cries of joy and jumping into the air, supporters of Germany's far-right AfD celebrated as they realised the scale of their election triumph in an ex-communist eastern state on Sunday.

data.title: Buriram, Jackson part ways
data.description: <p>Thai League 1 coaches are usually given time to fail before the axe falls -- sackings and resignations tend to pile up as a season wears on. This time, the upheaval has arrived before a ball has even been kicked.</p>

data.title: Hail the Hiro: Thai teenager bags historic ISU medal
data.description: <p>Hiro Kaewtathip made history by becoming the first Thai figure skater to win a medal at an ISU Grand Prix event.</p>

data.title: No rest for Kingdom's riders as bigger Asian Games test looms
data.description: <p>Thai sprinters raced out of their skins to spring a surprise at the Track Asia Cup 2026, lifting the Kingdom to fourth spot in the continental rankings -- but there was little time to savour the achievement, with the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya bearing down fast.</p>

data.title: Arsenal deliver statement fightback to end Chelsea's flying start
data.description: LONDON - Arsenal delivered an emphatic response to Chelsea's emergence as potential Premier League title contenders with a 2-1 win that ended their rivals' unbeaten start on Sunday.

data.title: 'Nothing has changed': FIFA confirms Infantino to run for re-election
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Gianni Infantino will stand in next March's FIFA presidential election, despite the backlash over his now-abandoned plan to bring private investment into the World Cup, football's global governing body announced Sunday.

data.title: With joy and grief, Palestinian football marks return
data.description: AL-RAM (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Palestinian sports commentator Khalil Jadallah has spent the past three years mourning the athletes killed in the Gaza war. As Palestinian football officially resumed this week, his return to the stadium proved bittersweet.

data.title: 'Truly scared': Blazes outpace firefighters in Indonesian Borneo
data.description: PONTIANAK (INDONESIA) - Toiling around the clock, haggard Indonesian firefighters on Borneo island cannot keep up with the blazes devouring landscapes and shrouding communities in a cloying haze.
